core_obligations: Use connection-invariance to convert subgroupoids to Galois-invariant Lie algebra subbundles.
Control every Cartesian power through the product Galois group.
Apply the simple-Lie-algebra subdirect-product argument and rule out invariant isomorphism graphs.
difficulty_reason: The statements concern algebraic differential subgroupoids in every Cartesian power, rather than only subgroups of a fixed Lie group. The author passes to connection-invariant Lie algebra bundles and the product differential Galois action; Lie-irreducibility excludes positive-dimensional factor projections, while simplicity and Goursat graphs rule out proper surjective subdirect subgroupoids. This is a structural differential-algebraic result, not a routine verification of a single example.
